description: Reads the open model the way the Eurocode Load Combinations plugin does: every static, moving (characteristic/frequent pairs), construction-stage, settlement and response-spectrum case with the action and subtype the plugin proposes, the detected bridge type, the default scope and factors (EN 1990 Annex A2 recommended, UK NA or Irish NA), each tab's gate, and the combinations already in the LCOM tables. Read-only.
name: ec_combinations_read
title: Read the model for Eurocode combinations
